name: Register Goat + Record Weight Offline + Sync + Search

gates.requirement: Goat registration is locally durable before success UI
Weight capture is locally durable before success UI
Local durability survives process/device restart
Outbox retry state machine is deterministic
Duplicate mutation has one authoritative effect
Expected stream version conflict behavior is proven
RLS attack from another farm fails
Cross-farm FK attack fails
Supabase authoritative transaction commits event/projection atomically
Monotonic pull cursor reconciles device state
Second-device visibility is proven
Search indexing is eventually updated
Meilisearch farm isolation is proven
Meilisearch outage cannot block authoritative capture
Meilisearch rebuild is demonstrated
Device clock drift is handled
Supabase Auth token expiry and re-auth work
Revoked farm access rejects pending mutations safely
Mutation/sync/search observability exists
Android + database CI pass canonical tests

activation_blockers: Connect a Supabase project/staging environment and configure publishable project credentials outside git.
Implement Supabase Auth/session handling and replace bootstrap farm/actor/device identifiers.
Implement client pull/reconciliation and second-device refresh.
Implement local search + Meilisearch search client and search fallback UX.
Add deterministic Meilisearch full rebuild/reconciliation command and test.
Provide/bundle the approved Inter font asset before UI certification.
Run CI and repair every build, migration, RLS and pgTAP failure.
Run fault, restart, clock-drift, revocation and two-device E2E tests.
